notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
Game Version: v1.0.5

Bugfixes
- Fixed an issue where the game was endlessly running.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
Game Version: v1.0.4

Bugfixes
- Fixed multiple bosses spawning in frozen level.
- Fixed Apex Venom Wing spawning in frozen level instead of Apex Mammoth.
- Fixed Nova Laser Lens not visible in the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
Game Version: v1.0.3

Updates
- Allowed critical hits on drone attacks.
- Balanced Meta Progression.
- Balanced Drone Enemies.
- Changed Reroll and Banish limit to 5.
- Controller Button for Dash changed to L3.
- Dash input is changed to both B and L3.

Bugfixes
- Fixed auto aim button during UI.
- Fixed Shield Regen in meta progression.
- Fixed Map 3 Enemies getting stuck on obstacles.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Game Version: v1.0.2

Updates
- Removed DNA Gem System from Meta Progression.
- Balanced Meta Progression.
- Balanced Early Game Enemies.
- Changed Tutorial stay duration to 10 seconds.
- Controller Button for Dash changed to L3.
- Controller Button for Auto Aim changed to Y.
- Disabled FPS Counter.

Bugfixes
- Fixed Mech Upgrades UI problems.
- Fixed Localization issues.
- Xeno Siphon Harvester Fixed.
